projects.name: Post-Quantum Security for Artemis zkML
projects.description: M.Tech thesis: replaced KZG polynomial commitments with FRI-Poseidon in the Artemis zkML framework to eliminate quantum vulnerability from Shor's algorithm
highlights: Identified KZG quantum vulnerability: Shor's algorithm recovers secret trapdoor in 10.9 hours on 64-bit curve
Demonstrated attack using BSGS recovering trapdoor in 52 microseconds (9-bit) to 10.9 hours (64-bit) on real MLP weights
Simulated Shor's algorithm using Qiskit Aer (24 qubits, 4096 shots) confirming quantum threat end-to-end
Replaced KZG with FRI-Poseidon across all 7 Artemis CP-SNARK commitment operations
Reduced commitment size from 64 bytes (ECC point) to 8 bytes (Merkle root), no trusted setup required
